decision: Extraction pass for issue #243, not a discovery search: the issue supplied the leads and this pass pinned them. Registered the TorchX suite, the TorchFold predictor implementation, the TorchScore evaluator and the TorchCraft design pipeline as four separate records, with no new pretrained generative model identity. Recorded the AlphaFold 3 weight setting used by every reported experiment and the README's gated checkpoint as two distinct configurations. Extracted 31 printed values: eight apparent dissociation constants of displayed designs, the 20 cells of Supplementary Table S9 and the three statistics of Supplementary Figure S4b. Registered the four computational benchmarks separately, each with status discovered because every pass-rate figure prints no numbers. 165 records in data/omics/torchcraft-20261115/batch.jsonl; nothing added to the store, and a different agent reviews the batch.
gaps: Figures 2f, 3i, 4c, 5c, 5d, S1, S2, S3, S5, S6, S7 and S9 print no numbers. Every computational pass rate, Rosetta interface-score distribution, docking score, affinity prediction and cyclisation fraction is therefore unextracted; no value was read off a bar or a pixel.

The number of designs expressed and tested per campaign target is not stated anywhere in the preprint. The generated pools (3,000 per minibinder target, 12,500 per VHH target) and the filters are recorded; no hit rate can be derived.
Only one representative design per target is displayed with a KD. Other tested designs, if any, are not reported.
No designed or tested sequence is printed or deposited: the preprint's data-availability statement offers the code and design protocols only.
The TorchFold report behind reference 21 could not be retrieved, so the predictor implementation's own benchmark claims are unverified beyond the README.
The gated Hugging Face release was not accessed, so no checkpoint file, hash or file list was seen, and whether trained weights are actually served at that URL is unconfirmed.
DeepMind's terms for the AlphaFold 3 parameters were not retrieved, so commercial usability of the evaluated configuration is not established.

Supplementary Table S1 prints one cyclic-peptide hyperparameter row; it does not separate the head-to-tail and disulfide-linked settings. The unregularised minibinder setting behind Figure 2e and S1 is not printed either.
The runtime table does not say which target or design task was timed, and NPU and GPU timings come from different machines, so the two platforms are not a controlled comparison.
No search was made for independent evaluations of TorchCraft; the preprint is two months old at the cutoff and no third-party result was sought.
coverage_claim: Bounded extraction pass for issue #243, lane structure-design and interactions, cutoff 2026-11-15. It covers arXiv:2609.19770v1 in full, the official project site, the TorchX repository README, LICENSE and design-module README at commit ebf9dc6676ecb1be505bc72f87de408995f0d8fd, and the gated Hugging Face dataset page as served without signing in. It is not a literature search of binder-design methods, not all-model coverage, and no value was reproduced.
